devdoc.details: Deployed once by RestaurantRegistry, so there is no owner and no setup step.      Payments are in the chain's native coin and go straight to the restaurant: this contract never      holds funds. Points are minted to the buyer in the same transaction as the payment.      Menu entries are never deleted, only hidden, so ids stay stable and old events stay meaningful.

params.name: Non-empty, at most `MAX_NAME_LENGTH` bytes. Cannot be changed later.
params.points: Points a customer earns per unit. Zero is allowed (an item that earns nothing).
params.price: Price of one unit in wei. Must not be zero.

params.cost: Points needed to claim it. Must not be zero.
params.name: Non-empty, at most `MAX_NAME_LENGTH` bytes. Cannot be changed later.

params.token: The token to pay with. It must be accepted by `restaurant` right now.

purchase(address,uint256,uint256).details: The payment is forwarded to the restaurant and the points are minted to the caller.      Reverts, and so mints nothing, when the restaurant cannot receive the payment.      A restaurant cannot buy from itself: that would only mint points for free.      This does not stop one person from using a second wallet. What points are worth to other      restaurants is controlled by the acceptance policy of those restaurants.

updateItem(uint256,uint128,uint64,bool).details: A hidden item cannot be bought. Past purchases are not affected.
